ingest(): parse, chunk and store the document as
approve(): only a principal that manages the office;
embeds the passages, writes Qdrant, then the FTS5
index and the state in one SQLite transaction,
supersedes the old version, logs the approval.
Safe parsing: real type detected from the bytes,
size limit, encrypted PDFs refused, DOCX checked
for zip bombs and macros, XML through defusedxml.

and chunker version, so a citation stays stable.
